mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(c.sign_amount, c.total_amount, c.amount, 0)), 0) FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId}) AS contract_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM crm_opty o WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_dict_data d WHERE d.dict_type = 'crm_opty_stage_closed_won' AND d.status = '0' AND d.dict_value = o.stage ) ) AS won_treatment_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c2.received_amount), 0) FROM crm_contract c2 WHERE c2.account_id = #{accountId}) AS received_total, (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(a.currency)), ''), 'CNY') FROM crm_account a WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}) AS currency, (SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM crm_contact cc WHERE cc.account_id = #{accountId}) AS member_count
